import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

def up(acc): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
W=up("P50093")

KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def kd(s,w=19):
    v=np.array([KD[a] for a in s]); h=w//2; o=np.full(len(s),np.nan)
    for i in range(h,len(s)-h): o[i]=v[i-h:i+h+1].mean()
    return o
kw=kd(W)

VDW={"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80}
MAXASA={"ALA":129,"ARG":274,"ASN":195,"ASP":193,"CYS":167,"GLU":223,"GLN":225,"GLY":104,"HIS":224,
        "ILE":197,"LEU":201,"LYS":236,"MET":224,"PHE":240,"PRO":159,"SER":155,"THR":172,"TRP":285,
        "TYR":263,"VAL":174}
def rsa(acc):
    meta=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()[0]
    txt=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    d=pd.DataFrame([dict(res=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),
        z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66]),el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]))
        for l in txt.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")])
    xyz=d[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(); rad=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in d.el])+1.4
    n=200; i=np.arange(n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    sph=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
    a=np.zeros(len(d))
    for k in range(len(d)):
        dd=np.linalg.norm(xyz-xyz[k],axis=1); nb=np.where((dd<rad+rad[k])&(dd>0))[0]
        pts=xyz[k]+sph*rad[k]; acc=np.ones(n,bool)
        for j in nb: acc&=(np.linalg.norm(pts-xyz[j],axis=1)>=rad[j])
        a[k]=4*np.pi*rad[k]**2*acc.sum()/n
    d["sasa"]=a
    p=d.groupby(["resi","res"],as_index=False).agg(sasa=("sasa","sum"),plddt=("b","mean"))
    p["rsa"]=100*p.sasa/p.res.map(MAXASA); return p

R={lab:rsa(acc) for acc,lab in [("Q99623","human PHB2"),("P50093","worm PHB-2"),
                                ("P35232","human PHB1"),("Q9BKU4","worm PHB-1")]}
CORE={"human PHB2":121,"worm PHB-2":120,"human PHB1":107,"worm PHB-1":110}
MOT={"human PHB2":"YQRL","worm PHB-2":"YRTL","human PHB1":"FTSI","worm PHB-1":"YLNI"}
COL={"human PHB2":"#2f6fb2","worm PHB-2":"#c9452b","human PHB1":"#8a8f98","worm PHB-1":"#b9bec6"}
print("RSA at X0 / X3 (AlphaFold monomer):")
for lab in CORE:
    p=R[lab]; c=CORE[lab]
    print(f"  {lab:<12} {MOT[lab]}@{c:<4} X0 RSA={p.loc[p.resi==c,'rsa'].iloc[0]:5.1f}%  "
          f"X3 RSA={p.loc[p.resi==c+3,'rsa'].iloc[0]:5.1f}%  mean pLDDT(window)={p[(p.resi>=c)&(p.resi<=c+3)].plddt.mean():.1f}")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.0,1.0,1.15],hspace=0.6,wspace=0.3)

axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
axA.plot(np.arange(1,len(W)+1),kw,color="#c9452b",lw=1.4)
axA.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.6)
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((20,-4.6),23,9.4,color="#f0c419",alpha=0.35,zorder=0))
axA.text(31.5,3.4,"TM 20-42\ntype II signal anchor",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((212,-4.6),26,9.4,color="#9ecae1",alpha=0.35,zorder=0))
axA.text(225,3.4,"coiled coil\n212-237",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axA.axvline(121.5,color="#1a1a1a",lw=1.2,ls="--")
axA.text(126,-3.9,"Y120-R-T-L123, aligned to human LIR Y121-Q-R-L124",fontsize=8,va="bottom")
axA.set_xlim(1,len(W)); axA.set_ylim(-4.6,4.8)
axA.set_xlabel("C. elegans PHB-2 residue (P50093, 294 aa)")
axA.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\nhydropathy, window 19")
axA.set_title("A  The candidate worm LIR sits 78 residues C-terminal to the single membrane anchor, on the intermembrane-space side",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")
axA.text(150,-2.9,"residues 43-294 face the intermembrane space (UniProt: single-pass type II, N-terminus in matrix)",
         fontsize=8,color="#444",ha="center")

axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0]); axB.axis("off")
hwin="LPSMYQRLGLDY"; wwin="LVHIYRTLGQNW"
hpos=list(range(117,129)); wpos=list(range(116,128))
axB.text(0,1.08,"B  Human PHB2 LIR window aligned to worm PHB-2\n     (global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, 62.9% identity)",
         fontsize=10,transform=axB.transAxes,va="top")
for k in range(12):
    x=0.055+k*0.078; core=4<=k<=7
    axB.text(x,0.86,str(hpos[k]),ha="center",fontsize=6.5,color="#777",transform=axB.transAxes)
    axB.text(x,0.68,hwin[k],ha="center",fontsize=14,family="monospace",transform=axB.transAxes,
             color="#2f6fb2" if core else "#555",weight="bold" if core else "normal")
    axB.text(x,0.545,"|" if hwin[k]==wwin[k] else ".",ha="center",fontsize=11,color="#333",transform=axB.transAxes)
    axB.text(x,0.40,wwin[k],ha="center",fontsize=14,family="monospace",transform=axB.transAxes,
             color="#c9452b" if core else "#555",weight="bold" if core else "normal")
    axB.text(x,0.26,str(wpos[k]),ha="center",fontsize=6.5,color="#777",transform=axB.transAxes)
    if core: axB.add_patch(Rectangle((x-0.034,0.355),0.068,0.44,fill=False,ec="#333",lw=1.0,
                                     transform=axB.transAxes,clip_on=False))
axB.text(0.0,0.68,"human",fontsize=8,transform=axB.transAxes)
axB.text(0.0,0.40,"worm",fontsize=8,transform=axB.transAxes)
axB.text(0.055+4*0.078,0.14,"X0",ha="center",fontsize=8,transform=axB.transAxes)
axB.text(0.055+7*0.078,0.14,"X3",ha="center",fontsize=8,transform=axB.transAxes)
axB.text(0.5,0.0,"X0 aromatic retained (Y121 to Y120), X3 hydrophobic retained (L124 to L123),\nX1 Q to R and X2 R to T substituted. No acidic residue at -1 to -4 in either species.",
         ha="center",fontsize=8.5,transform=axB.transAxes)

axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
for lab in CORE:
    c=CORE[lab]; p=R[lab]; off=np.arange(-4,6)
    vals=[p.loc[p.resi==c+o,"rsa"].iloc[0] if (p.resi==c+o).any() else np.nan for o in off]
    axC.plot(off,vals,"o-",color=COL[lab],lw=1.6,ms=4,label=f"{lab}  {MOT[lab]} at {c}")
axC.axvspan(-0.4,3.4,color="#dddddd",alpha=0.6,zorder=0)
axC.set_xticks(np.arange(-4,6)); axC.set_xlabel("offset from X0 of the motif")
axC.set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility (%)")
axC.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False)
axC.set_title("C  AlphaFold monomer exposure of the window is\n     the same in PHB1, which binds LC3 only indirectly",fontsize=10,loc="left")

axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:]); axD.axis("off")
tab=[("Homo sapiens PHB2","Q99623","LPSMYQRLGLDY","YQRL",121,"experimentally defined LIR"),
     ("Mus musculus Phb2","O35129","LPSMYQRLGLDY","YQRL",121,"identical to human"),
     ("Saccharomyces cerevisiae Phb2","P50085","LPTIYRTLGQDY","YRTL",138,"same core as worm"),
     ("Caenorhabditis elegans phb-2","P50093","LVHIYRTLGQNW","YRTL",120,"target of this analysis"),
     ("Caenorhabditis briggsae","A8WTY0","LVHIYRTLGQNW","YRTL",120,"Chromadorea"),
     ("Caenorhabditis nigoni","A0A2G5V3Y9","LVHIYRTLGQNW","YRTL",120,"Chromadorea"),
     ("Ancylostoma ceylanicum","A0A016WXG8","LVRIYRTLGQNW","YRTL",141,"Chromadorea, Strongylida"),
     ("Toxocara canis","A0A0B2V572","LPKIYRMLGQNW","YRML",121,"Chromadorea, Ascaridida"),
     ("Brugia malayi","A0A0K0IZY5","LPKIYRMLGQNW","YRML",113,"Chromadorea, Spirurida"),
     ("Trichinella britovi","A0A0V1DA62","LPKIYRTLGVDW","YRTL",120,"Enoplea, deep branch"),
     ("Trichinella pseudospiralis","A0A0V1ISV6","LPKIYRTLGVDW","YRTL",120,"Enoplea, deep branch"),
     ("Homo sapiens PHB1","P35232","LPRIFTSIGEDY","FTSI",107,"paralog control, no direct LC3 binding"),
     ("Caenorhabditis elegans PHB-1","Q9BKU4","LPNIYLNIGLDY","YLNI",110,"paralog control, same fold position")]
axD.text(0,1.0,"D  The aromatic-x-x-hydrophobic core is invariant across Nematoda, and is also present in both prohibitin paralogs",
         fontsize=10,transform=axD.transAxes)
hdr=["species / protein","accession","window equivalent to human 117-128","core","X0 pos","note"]
xs=[0.0,0.215,0.325,0.525,0.585,0.655]
for x,h in zip(xs,hdr): axD.text(x,0.905,h,fontsize=8,weight="bold",transform=axD.transAxes)
for i,row in enumerate(tab):
    y=0.835-i*0.064
    ctrl="paralog control" in row[5]
    col="#c9452b" if "elegans phb-2" in row[0] else ("#8a8f98" if ctrl else "#222")
    for x,v in zip(xs,row):
        axD.text(x,y,str(v),fontsize=8,color=col,transform=axD.transAxes,
                 family="monospace" if x in (0.325,0.525) else None)
